concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-015 (conduct power analysis and document detectable effect size, power, and required sample size) is not referenced in any phase or task; the plan never produces the required documentation.

Success Criterion SC-004 (data acquisition completeness: ≥95 % species with ≥100 records after thinning and ≥99 % non‑null climate values) is absent from the plan; no task or metric is defined to measure or enforce this criterion.
